semantics: Evidence nodes locate existing records. Dependencies are research obligations, not proof imports. Atlas and arrow collection remain authoritative in their own scopes and are not merged or republished here.

conjectures.statement: The matter atlas records constituent/isotope claims with separate observation, model and physical-identification statuses.
conjectures.scope: Catalogue evidence, not a theorem that the named constituents are physically identified.

conjectures.statement: The source collection retains proton, neutron, electron, neutrino candidate, reversed-electron positron candidate and shared-edge photon candidate as distinct source records.
conjectures.scope: Geometric generators and retained continuation modes, not a universal spin/charge/energy identification.

conjectures.statement: Construct a versioned claim-by-claim correspondence between atlas entries and the newer arrow records without equating the tetrahedral spinor, five-cycle geometry, and physical species.
conjectures.next_action: Compare source IDs and per-claim statuses; record the newer reversed positron and photon-stage references separately. Distinguish missing links from contradictions; do not silently rewrite atlas scientific claims.
conjectures.acceptance: Explicit scope-preserving source links and unresolved differences; no inference of charge conjugation from seed reversal.

conjectures.statement: Under the supplied identification of consecutive A,B,C vertices, electron and reversed positron paths admit two overlapping photon-shaped directed supports after composed-path shorthand; not an independent output factorization.
conjectures.scope: Seven vertices and ten primitive arrow occurrences; two displayed six-arrow supports expand to eighteen primitive usages. Paths and their owners remain retained; geometric/metric gluing, filled faces and photon-mode intertwining are not established.

conjectures.statement: An actual source operation realizes two separately retained photon-candidate outputs from the glued seeds, preserving shared information, metric and dynamics rather than copying path histories as independent states.
conjectures.next_action: Construct the occurrence-to-path incidence map, quantify reused histories and retained residuals, then test a source-authorized reversible encoder or give a scoped obstruction. Audit whether triangle filling and the conjugate photon continuation plane are transported by that same map.
conjectures.acceptance: Source operation and metric/state map with retained residuals, independent-output semantics, coherence-face witnesses and continuation intertwining; a graph motif alone is insufficient.

conjectures.statement: Bind the chosen output construction to prepared electron/positron inputs and independently identified photon scattering channels with conservation and normalized readouts.
conjectures.next_action: Carry only an explicitly constructed seed operation to the low-energy photon-channel gate; leave physical preparation, scale, bosonic channel structure and readout obligations visible.
conjectures.acceptance: Independent physical-channel justification and normalized amplitudes, not seed naming or fitted branching counts.

conjectures.statement: Review a source-faithful seed composition and its stated physical or conditional scope without importing catalogue labels as proof.
